query:
SELECT 
  cc.nome as conta_nome,
  cc.classificacao,
  CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) as valor
FROM lancamento_custo lc
JOIN conta_custo cc ON cc.id = lc.contaCustoId
WHERE lc.periodoCustoId = 60001
ORDER BY CAST(lc.valor AS DECIMAL(15,2)) DESC;
